notes:
Initial discovery with head of search (Dr. Anjali Rao). Heavy PHI workload: discharge notes, progress notes, imaging reports. Wants RAG for clinician-facing search with reranking by clinical relevance and provenance. POC scope: 3M docs (text only), embeddings + vector index + reranker layer. Key asks: p95 latency under 150ms for single-record retrieval + top-5 rerank within 300ms; strong audit logs for every query (user id, patient id hashed, route, model version); retention controls per legal (default 30d KV cache, long-term per-case retention). Quote from call: "We cannot accept black-box model hops — provenance & explainability are table stakes." They asked for example audit logs and KMS flow.

POC notes:
- Started ingestion test 2025-11-25 (S3 -> staging). Indexing estimate: 3M docs -> 120M vectors (using chunking) unless we adjust chunk size.
- Concerned about cost-per-query: target <$0.03/q for typical clinician query (embedding + rerank). Need Optimize recommendations on batching and quantization.
- Network: prefer private deployment (VPC peering) or on-prem connector in their Azure tenancy. Compliance team will only allow Private + customer-managed keys.
- Security review in progress: supplied SOC2 & ISO certs; asked for HIPAA BAA draft. Legal expects contract language by next procurement meeting.

Quotes & feedback:
- "If we can't hit p95 <150ms for the primary clinician path, adoption won't move forward." — Director of Clinical Informatics
- "We need to see token-level cost breakdown and clear routing rules for fallback models." — CTO

Integration dependencies:
- Epic FHIR search endpoints for patient document metadata (work with integration team)
- On-prem connector for S3-like archive (cold storage)

POC success criteria (customer-defined):
1) Ingest 3M docs into searchable index with provenance linking back to original doc ids.
2) Query p95 <150ms (primary retrieve), end-to-end rerank top-5 <300ms.
3) Cost per production query <= $0.03 at expected QPS (50 qps peak per region). 
4) Signed BAA and audit/logging pipeline to customer SIEM.
